info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of International Business

description.describe_ch:
課程旨在幫助學生瞭解產業中的人力資源問題，掌握國際人力資源管理的方法。包括招聘（全球和本地資源）；培訓與發展；績效管理；全面性獎勵；跨國公司雇傭和跨國移轉；跨國企業併購的人力管理，透過人力資源管理實現企業社會責任和永續性。
課程將幫助學生
- 深入瞭解與人力資源管理的理論、技能
- 瞭解日益全球化對人力資源管理的影響，
- 明確並理解人力資源管理中的道德問題
將最新的研究證據和理論融入課程，並鼓勵學生思考如何將知識應用於實務。同時分析組織和員工如何從國際人力資源管理領域的最新研究和知識中獲益。

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解如何將國際人力資源管理研究證據和理論應用於組織及其員工（並使其受益）。
targets.describe_en: Develop students' analytical skills and understanding of how international human resource management research evidence and theory can be applied to (and benefit) organizations and their employees.

targets.describe_ch: 為學生提供發展分析思維的機會，提高他們的自我管理、自我組織和解決問題的能力。
targets.describe_en: Provide students with opportunities to develop analytical thinking and enhance their self-management, self-organization and problem-solving skills.

Suggested Texts for the Course:
 
1. Briscoe, D., Schuler, R., & Tarique, I. (2022). International human resource management: Policies and practices for multinational enterprises. Routledge. 6th Edition.

gradeRules.evalb_memo_en: Points are deducted for unathorized absences. 3 unathorized absences = 5% deduction. 4 or more unathorized absences = 10% deduction.

In-Class Quiz (test) based on class content. The schedule shows which weeks will have an in-class quiz. There will be 10 in total, each containing 10 questions (100 questions in total) and students will recieve 1 point per correct answer.

Post-presentation Group Interview (10%).  
Each participant will be asked 2 individual questions to test understanding of the topic.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Please attend the course as much as possible. Please notify the teacher of any absences by e-mail. 
No listening to music - using headphones / earphones in class.
Phones need to be on silent. 
Please avoid talking when others are speaking / presenting. 
Please visit the iLearn page at least weekly to ensure you are updated and aware of any preparation required for each class.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
• Please follow Feng Chia University regulations and guidelines. 
  • When completing assessed work please ensure that the work is your own. 
  • Check your referencing and ensure you have not plagiarised. 
  • Please follow the assessment guidance and ensure you have completed the task and all requirements before submitting the work. 
  • Please make a note of the deadlines. 
  • If you have used AI you will need to complete a form (provided by the instructor on iLearn) to declare how you have used AI, what search terms/instructions you entered, and how you have used the AI responses to ensure your work is original and your own.
